title: Tiny Mob Farm CE
description: Added several small creature farms and a capture rope, helping you obtain rare materials that are otherwise hard to get
body:
# Introduction
This mod is a community version of Tiny Mob Farm. It is currently planned for versions 1.12.2 and 1.16.5, with the 1.12.2 version already completed.

## Changes
Compared to the original 1.12.2 version of Tiny Mob Farm, the following content has been added/changed:
* Added a Mechanical Mob Farm—allowing lassos to be piped in and out.
* Added a config toggle: when the container beneath the farm is full, it will stop working, halting durability consumption and preventing item drops.

# Overview
This mod adds several miniature mob farms and a lasso that can be used to capture mobs. 
It helps you automate the acquisition of hard-to-get materials, such as Wither Skeleton Skulls, Ghast Tears, and more.
Mob farms generate mob drops over time, with different tiers of farms operating at different speeds.
The Wooden Mob Farm is the slowest, followed by the Stone Mob Farm, while the Ender Mob Farm is the fastest.

# About Permissions

# 介绍
本模组为Tiny Mob Farm的社区版本，目前计划制作1.12.2与1.16.5版本，其中1.12.2版本已经完成。
## 改动
相较于Tiny Mob Farm的1.12.2版本，增加/改变了以下内容
添加了机械版本的生物农场——可以使用管道抽入抽出套索。
在config中加入开关，当农场下方容器为满时，会停止工作，不在消耗耐久，也不会产生掉落物。

# 概述
这个模组添加了几个迷你刷怪场以及一个可以抓捕生物的套索。
它可以帮助你自动化的取得一些难以获得的材料，比如凋灵骷髅头，恶魂之泪等等。
刷怪场随着时间的推移产生怪物的掉落物，不同等级的刷怪场的速度不一样。
木质刷怪场最慢的，石质刷怪场次之，而末影刷怪场则是最快的。
